com.unitech.lib.reader

Class BaseReader

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.unitech.lib.reader.BaseReader
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    com.unitech.lib.device.IReader, com.unitech.lib.transport.event.IConnectStateEventListener
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    HT730Reader, RG768Reader, RP902Reader

    public abstract class BaseReader
extends java.lang.Object
implements com.unitech.lib.device.IReader, com.unitech.lib.transport.event.IConnectStateEventListener
    The BaseReader class is a class that controls device in connection with unitech's equipment, receives data from device, and delivers it to the application program. The BaseReader class is an abstract class that must be implemented by inheriting from BaseReader.
